usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, KRW per USD (매매기준율)

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, consumer price index (all items, 2020=100), from Ministry of Data and Statistics
inflation_cpi.note: Index 120.43 in Sep 2026 against 117.06 in Sep 2025 (same series, https://ecos.bok.or.kr/api/StatisticSearch/sample/json/kr/1/10/901Y009/M/202509/202509/0) = 2.9% year on year.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Korea 2% target; CPI averaged 3.1% a year 2021-2025 (ECOS annual index 100 to 116.61)
inflation_projection.note: The 2% target is credible but inflation has run near 3% and the bank is raising rates, so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.note: Raised to 2.75% in July and 3.00% in August 2026; held at 3.00% on 22 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Dealsite (Nov 2024): low-cost demand deposits pay about 0.1% a year
savings_account_rate.note: Article says low-cost deposits (ordinary demand and passbook deposits) pay about 0.1% a year; internet-bank parking accounts pay around 2% with conditions. Source dated November 2024 (older than 2025).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, deposit banks' new time deposits under 6 months (weighted average)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Series covers all maturities under 6 months; 2.97% in August.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, deposit banks' new 1-year time deposits (weighted average)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Major banks' headline 1-year rates were 3.50-3.60% in October 2026.

dps_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, deposit banks' new installment savings (정기적금, weighted average)
dps_rate.note: Volatile month to month (3.99% July, 3.72% August) because of promotional products.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, deposit banks' savings-type deposits, new transactions (weighted average)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Balance-basis total deposit rate was 2.20% at end-August 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Economy and Finance October 2026 retail government bond issue (via SBS Biz, 30 Sep 2026)
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: 5-year retail government bond: 4.275% coupon (September 5-year auction rate) plus 0.05 point bonus, compounded and paid at maturity; 10-year 4.79%, 20-year 4.95%.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, Monetary Stabilization Bond 91-day yield
tbill_91d_rate.note: Korea issues no regular 91-day treasury bill; the central bank's 91-day bond is the standard 3-month government rate.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, 5-year Korea Treasury Bond yield

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Korea ECOS, 10-year Korea Treasury Bond yield

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Korea, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 15.4% withheld at source (14% national plus 1.4% local income tax); final unless interest and dividends exceed KRW 20 million a year. PwC page last reviewed 2 July 2026.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Newsis (Mar 2023) on retail government bond tax rules
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest is taxed separately at 14% (plus 1.4% local tax) on up to KRW 200 million of purchases per person if held to maturity; early redemption loses the benefit. Source dated March 2023 (older than 2025).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation, protection limit page
deposit_insurance_limit.note: KRW 100 million (principal plus interest) per depositor per financial institution; raised from KRW 50 million from 1 September 2025 (KDIC home page notice).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Regulation on the maximum interest rate under the Interest Limitation Act
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal maximum interest rate of 20% a year on loan contracts since 7 July 2021; card loans and revolving balances are held to the same statutory ceiling. Rule dates from 2021 (older than 2025) and is still in force.

equity_return_low.sourceName: KOSPI 2,008 (31 Oct 2016) to 2,399 (30 Dec 2024): about 2% a year price return before the 2025-26 rally (ECOS 802Y001)
equity_return_low.note: Low case matching KOSPI's weak 2016-2024 record before the recent rally.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate plus 4 points: 1-year time deposit 3.57% and 1-year government bond 3.59% before 15.4% tax (about 3.0% after tax)
equity_return_base.note: KOSPI's 10-year price gain (about 11% a year to 5,731 in Oct 2026) comes mostly from a 2025-26 rally, so the base is capped at the after-tax safe rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: KOSPI 2,008 (31 Oct 2016) to 5,731 (30 Oct 2026), about 11% a year price return (ECOS 802Y001)
equity_return_high.note: High case near the full 10-year KOSPI record including the recent rally.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold in won; USD/KRW from Bank of Korea ECOS
gold_return_low.note: Low case if gold stalls and the won strengthens, as it did in 2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Long-run USD gold trend about 5% plus about 1% expected won depreciation
gold_return_base.note: Gold in won follows the dollar gold price plus mild long-run won depreciation.

gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold decade or a weaker won.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: 1-year time deposit 3.57% and 1-year government bond 3.59% before 15.4% tax (about 3.0% after tax)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case if the base rate falls back to 2% and deposit rates follow.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year time deposit 3.57% and 1-year government bond 3.59% before 15.4% tax (about 3.0% after tax)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base equal to the after-tax 1-year deposit rate (3.57% x 0.846).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case locking in retail government bonds or 5-10 year treasury yields after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Industry-wide life claim settlement ratio not found in this research pass (the Financial Supervisory Service publishes non-payment ratios by insurer).

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Indicative term life (정기보험) premium rates per KRW 1,000 of cover not found from a published source in this research pass.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay not found from a published source in this research pass (National Health Insurance covers most costs with 20% inpatient coinsurance plus non-covered items).

health_premium_table.note: Private indemnity health insurance (실손보험) is priced per policy, not per amount of cover; no published premium table per KRW 100,000 found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Health CPI rose about 1.1% a year 2020-2025 (ECOS 901Y009, item F)
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured medical prices rise slowly under NHI fee controls, but non-covered care and ageing push spending faster, so health costs use the 2.5% headline planning rate.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Education CPI rose about 1.6% a year 2020-2025 (ECOS 901Y009, item J)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education CPI is low, but private tutoring spending grows faster, so 3% is used.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via Measured World
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source reproducing UN WPP 2024; ages 60 and 70 and sex breakdown not found in this pass.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN WPP 2024 medium variant via PopulationPyramid.net; World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 29.3 (2025, World Bank), 57.9 (2040) and 97.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/republic-of-korea/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Pension pension age schedule (Korean Wikipedia, National Pension of South Korea)
retirement_age_default.note: National Pension old-age pension starts at 65 for anyone born in 1969 or later (63 for 1961-64, 64 for 1965-68); the legal minimum mandatory retirement age in firms is 60. Secondary source (Korean Wikipedia).

retirement_age_government.note: Article 74(1): public officials retire at 60 unless another law says otherwise, leaving on 30 June or 31 December of that year (current text).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: 1-year time deposit 3.57% and 1-year government bond 3.59% before 15.4% tax (about 3.0% after tax)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case if deposit rates fall back with the base rate.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 1-year time deposit 3.57% and 1-year government bond 3.59% before 15.4% tax (about 3.0% after tax)
retirement_return_base.note: Held at the after-tax 1-year deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Retail government bonds and laddered treasury bonds after 15.4% tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case for locking in 5-10 year government bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of deposits (3.0% after tax) and equity low case (3%)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix in a weak decade.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of after-tax safe rate 3% and equity base 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 7% and half safe assets at 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix with equity at the high case 11%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case if equities repeat their recent 10-year record.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Ministry of Health and Welfare, Basic Pension (기초연금) 2026 standard amount
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Notice of 23 January 2026: standard monthly amount KRW 349,700 for a single recipient in 2026; couples receive 20% less each.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Pensions in South Korea (Wikipedia); Ministry of Health and Welfare Basic Pension site
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Basic Pension goes to people aged 65+ in the bottom 70% by income and assets; 2026 selection threshold KRW 2.47 million a month for a single person and KRW 3.952 million for a couple (basicpension.mohw.go.kr notice of 23 January 2026).

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Employee Retirement Benefit Security Act, Article 8
gratuity_rule.note: Article 8(1): at least 30 days of average wages per year of continuous service (average wage = last 3 months' pay / calendar days); many employers use a DB or DC retirement pension instead.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Pension (Korean Wikipedia, National Pension of South Korea)
public_pension_scheme.note: Residents 18 to under 60 must join; pension age 65 for anyone born in 1969 or later (63 for 1961-64, 64 for 1965-68); National Pension Act Article 51(2) adjusts pension amounts by the national CPI change after committee review; benefits are taxed as pension income.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold monthly in 3, 5, 10 and 20-year terms; interest compounds and is paid at maturity.

tbill_91d.note: No regular 91-day treasury bill; central bank bonds trade through brokerages.

gold.note: Physical gold bars are sold to individuals; gold can also be traded on the exchange's regulated gold market.

insuranceRegulator.name: Financial Services Commission
insuranceRegulator.note: Supervision is carried out by the Financial Supervisory Service.

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Supervisory Service (complaints and dispute mediation)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Basic Pension (Ministry of Health and Welfare)

statistics.name: Ministry of Data and Statistics (formerly Statistics Korea)
